pages.text: Awakening is not understanding. To truly learn, you must $(l)study$().$(br2)At a Research Table, offer $(l)4 Dull Shards$() and $(l)50 mana$() to gain $(l)2 Knowledge$(). Your first study makes you an $(l)Apprentice$().
pages.title: The Research Table

pages.text: Knowledge is spent in the Spellbook to learn spells and open schools of magic.
